concerns.text: No task measures total pipeline runtime to verify the ≤ 6 hour feasibility requirement (SC-008). Add a task (e.g., T013) that records the end‑to‑end execution time and asserts it is ≤ 6 hours on the target CI runner.

The plan expects a `results/statistics/binning_sensitivity_table.csv` output, but the only task generating a binning table (T008) writes `results/sensitivity/binning_results.csv`. Add or rename a task to produce the exact file path and name required by the plan.
